key_insight: CAST represents 3D shapes with paired top and bottom depth images, excluding undercuts along a selected mold-opening direction by construction.
engineering_relevance: The shared representation connects generative design with FEA-guided structural refinement while preserving a selected two-part-mold pull-direction constraint.
method: Encode each shape as paired depth maps defining one material interval along the pull direction.
Train diffusion models to generate candidate shapes in this representation.
Refine both depth boundaries using FEA guidance and a volume penalty.
evidence_signal: Using 211 SimJEB bracket designs for training, FEA-guided refinement reduced compliance in 193 of 200 generated candidates, with a median reduction of 36.8% in the optimization FEA model.
watch_item: Undercut exclusion is direction-specific, not a guarantee of full casting feasibility; reconstruction can also add material by filling occluded regions.
paper_title: CAST: Cast-Admissible Generative Design and Shape Optimization with Paired Depth Images
